method: Built-in image_gen, used as surface textures only; meshes modeled through Blender MCP
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: tileable base-color texture for a real Blender 3D model, NOT a rendered prop or character. Generate a single square 2048 x 2048 image, filling every pixel edge to edge with an orthographic macro scan of old blackened gunmetal iron used for battered cybernetic zombie equipment. Approximately a 20-centimeter square physical sample. Dense fine intersecting scratches, localized silvery rubbing, subtle brown oxidation, tiny pits, old black oily smudges and accumulated dried dirt; charcoal graphite overall, varied dark-gray and muted brown patches. Surface irregularity at multiple scales, realistic physically photographed details. Very flat diffuse cross-polarized lighting suitable for albedo, no highlights, no directional illumination, no shadows. Continuous metal surface with no edges, no panel borders, no seams, no screws, no text, no logos, no objects, no background. Seamlessly tiling edges. It must feel aged, filthy and used, not polished, smooth, plastic, stylized, or simply white noise.

Worn utilitarian equipment, no clean shiny plastic, no cartoon treatment.
